citations.title: British American Tobacco Earnings Q3 2026

sentences.text: British American Tobacco is pursuing a transformation to a predominantly smokeless business, targeting 50% of revenue from non-combustibles by 2035 and 50 million consumers of smokeless products by 2030.
In the first half of 2026 New Categories revenue rose 18.0% to 1,928 million pounds and smokeless products reached 19.8% of group revenue, up 1.6 percentage points versus 2025.
Profitability of that portfolio is improving, with a New Categories contribution margin of 13.8% and contribution up 54.7%.

sentences.text: Combustibles continue to fund the transformation, with revenue up 2.1% driven by the U.S. and AME.

sentences.quote: Free cash flow before dividends rose 85% to GBP 2.3 billion, with an operating cash conversion rate of 80%. This strong cash performance supports the company's capital allocation strategy
sentences.text: Cash generation supports shareholder returns, with free cash flow before dividends up 85% to 2.3 billion pounds, a 1.3 billion pound buyback and a progressive dividend.
